title: Barcode scan route answers all 191 real grocery barcodes with no error and a median of 1.3 s
evidence: GET /api/identify?gtin=... x191 (answers.csv): 191 of 191 status 200, 0 server errors; time p50 1317 ms, p95 1831 ms. Route is the one api.js identify() uses. server.ts claudeRangeAsk(): 'if (!claudeAllowed(req)) return undefined', and claudeAllowed is true only for header x-shin-claude: 1, so without it no Claude call; pack read refused ('pack_read_developer_only'); no Gemini ('Pexi uses Gemini for nothing').

title: Only about half of real grocery scans get a price: 98 of 191 (51%); the other 93 get a wide category bracket and no verdict
evidence: answers.csv, 191 barcodes from Open Food Facts Canada (popular, 8 groups): found 187 (98%), priced 98 (51%), verdict given 98. Price basis: 55 this exact product, 28 own prices of a related size or few sightings, 15 category averages. 93 found items have range basis fixed_prior, noRangeReason pool_too_wide or no_shin_prices, median null, verdict null. Priced share by group: dairy 39/60, bread 4/16, snacks 10/32, drinks 12/18, frozen 3/14, pantry 21/40, produce 6/8, household 3/3. Confidence of the 98 verdicts: high 31, medium 24, low 43. Caveat: the list comes from Open Food Facts, the same source the catalogue was built from, so found rate is optimistic.
fix: Widen shop price coverage for bread, snacks, frozen (crawler), and say a plain 'we have no price yet, type the shelf price' for the 93
